info.name: Embedded Consumer Wallets Balances Jurisdictions API

items.docs:
Returns all countries and regions where Cadana supports statutory filing.
Each jurisdiction includes a summary of filing types, payroll frequency, and currency.

Returns full configuration for a jurisdiction: required employee fields,
filing types, statutory benefits, compliance rules, and termination rules.

The embedded field lists (`employeeFields`, `employerFields`) cover
filing-scope fields only. For the complete set — including
calculation-scope fields — use
`GET /v1/statutory/jurisdictions/{country_code}/required-fields`.

info.name: List filing types for a jurisdiction

items.docs:
Returns every type of statutory return that must be filed in this jurisdiction.
Each filing type includes the government authority, frequency, and required data.

info.name: Get required fields for tax calculation and statutory filing

params.name: scope
params.description: Filter fields by scope — "calculation" for tax engine inputs, "filing" for statutory return fields. Omit to return all fields.

items.docs:
Returns all fields required for tax calculation and/or statutory filing
in this jurisdiction. This is a **discovery endpoint** — it tells you
what data needs to be collected for both persons (workers) and businesses
(employers).

Each field includes:
- **`entity`** — Who the field belongs to: `person` (worker data) or
  `business` (employer data)
- **`scope`** — Whether the field is needed for `calculation` (tax engine input),
